backup.heading: Backups and restore
backup.lookupFailed: Managed backup access could not be checked. This does not mean your backups are missing. Reload this page before trying a backup operation.
backup.enroll: Ask an administrator to confirm this exact game server is enrolled in managed hosting and link its managed record.
backup.permissions: Ask the managed owner for manager access, or an administrator to verify your managed ownership.
backup.return: Return to this tab to view real backup history, create a backup, or restore an available save.
backup.migration: A standalone server needs a planned migration first. Creating a new managed server does not copy this server or its saves.
backup.servers: View managed servers and setup options
backup.mappingRequired: This live server is not connected to managed backups for your account. Live console access alone does not grant access to backup history, backup creation, or save restore.
backup.accessRequired: The linked managed server is unavailable to your account. Ask an administrator to check the server link and your managed access. Live console access alone does not grant access to backup history, backup creation, or save restore.
file.heading: Connect save and configuration transfers
file.lookupFailed: Managed file access could not be checked. This does not mean your save or configuration is missing. Reload this page before trying a transfer.
file.enroll: Ask an administrator to confirm this exact game server is enrolled in managed hosting and link its managed record.
file.permissions: Ask the managed owner for manager access, or an administrator to verify your managed ownership. Only the managed owner can import configuration.
file.return: Return to this tab to view the current campaign save and managed configuration and use the permitted transfers.
file.migration: A standalone server needs a planned migration first. Creating a new managed server does not copy this server or its saves.
file.servers: View managed servers and setup options
file.mappingRequired: This live server is not connected to managed file transfers for your account. Live console access alone does not grant access to saves or configuration.
file.accessRequired: The linked managed server is unavailable to your account. Ask an administrator to check the server link and your managed access. Live console access alone does not grant access to saves or configuration.
visibility.heading: Connect directory visibility
visibility.lookupFailed: Managed visibility could not be checked. The current directory setting is unknown; reload before trying to change it.
visibility.enroll: Ask an administrator to confirm this exact game server is enrolled in managed hosting and link its managed record. A standalone server needs a planned migration first.
visibility.permissions: Ask an administrator to verify the managed owner. Live console ownership and operator access do not grant permission to change directory visibility.
visibility.return: Return to Settings. The managed owner can choose Public or Private and save; other authorized accounts can view the current setting.
visibility.migration: Linking a server does not publish it. Creating a new managed server does not migrate this server or its saves. Directory visibility does not grant management access or change game connection permissions.
visibility.servers: View managed servers and setup options
visibility.mappingRequired: This live server has no managed visibility record available to your account.
visibility.accessRequired: The linked managed server is unavailable to your account. Ask an administrator to check the server link and your managed access.

operation.update.label: Update
operation.stop.confirmation: Stop the live Bannerlord server? Connected players will be disconnected.
operation.restart.confirmation: Restart the live Bannerlord server? Connected players will be disconnected briefly.
operation.update.confirmation: Check for and apply the latest configured server image? If a new image exists, the container will be recreated and connected players will be disconnected. The previous container is retained for rollback.
access.noOwner: No owner is assigned. Only administrators can manage this server.
action.missingAccount: No registered member has that email address.
action.directoryTooLarge: The member directory is too large to verify a unique owner safely.
action.uniqueOwnerRequired: Assign exactly one server owner before adding operators.
action.ownerHasAccess: The server owner already has management access.
action.accountBusy: The account is busy. Refresh assignments and retry the same change.
action.addFailed: The operator could not be added.
action.operatorMissing: That operator account could not be found.
action.notOperator: That account is not an operator for this server.
action.removeFailed: The operator could not be removed.
console.ready: Ready to connect to the console gateway.
console.notConfigured: CONSOLE_GATEWAY_URL is not configured with a secure WebSocket URL.
console.sessionExpired: Your Supabase session is no longer available. Sign in again.
console.authenticationNotConfigured: Authentication is not configured. Add the Supabase environment variables and restart the server.
console.loadingState: Server access verified. Loading container state…
console.authenticatedNotice: Authenticated. Waiting for the container attach…
console.attached: Live container output and standard input are connected.
console.attachedReadOnly: Live container output is connected. Stdin requires a container maintenance restart.
console.readOnlyNotice: Container attached read-only because Docker stdin is disabled.
console.stopped: Control channel connected. The container is stopped.
console.stateUnavailable: The container state could not be loaded.
console.malformedFrame: A malformed output frame was ignored.
console.gatewayError: The console gateway reported an error.
console.unreachable: The secure console gateway could not be reached.
console.inputHint: Enter to send · Commands go to container stdin, not a host shell.
console.inputUnavailable: Console input is unavailable until the running container is connected with stdin enabled.

ionos.heading: IONOS infrastructure
ionos.intro: This is the live IONOS inventory. Existing managed resources remain available, but new-server provisioning is currently paused.
ionos.firstServer: The first Create server operation also creates the website-managed data center and public LAN.
ionos.creationDisabled: New IONOS server provisioning is currently disabled.
ionos.networkNotice: New Cubes use a public LAN with an ingress firewall that permits SSH on TCP 22 only. Game ports and Bannerlord deployment are not configured yet.
ionos.pausedNotice: Inventory and destruction support remain available for previously managed IONOS resources.
